figures.caption: TABLE I. The example data with 10 stores. See text for details on the data features.

FIG. 1. The gene fitness values for Tab. I over 100 iteration comparing DomBal = DB with AltSel = AS evolutionary strategies (we take harmonic initial values γ (0) j = 1/m = 1/7 for all genes 1 ≤ j ≤ 7).

FIG. 2. The organism fitness values for Tab. I over 100 iteration comparing DomBal = DB with AltSel = AS evolutionary strategies. The organism/store with the highest fitness is thus the fittest player in the evolutionary game.

FIG. 3. Relative deviation from mean distribution for DomBal = DS and AltSel = AS combinations of evolutionary strategies. The stores A-J are shown along the x-axis while the y-axis represents how much more or less should be distributed.
